newsitem.title: GREECE: Natl Bank/Greece to cut depo, loan rates Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: Natl Bank/Greece to cut depo, loan rates Nov 28.

text.p: National Bank of Greece, the largest commercial bank in the country, will cut its deposit rates 50 basis points and its lending rates 25 basis points effective November 28, it said in a statement.
Earlier, a high-level source told Reuters that the deposit and loan rate reductions would be effective Monday, December 2.
The base deposit rate will be cut to 10.75 percent from 11.25 percent, and the current accounts rate to 9.25 percent from 9.75 percent, it said.
Consumer loan rates will be cut to 23.75 from 24 percent, personal loan rates to 24.75 percent from 25 percent and credit cards to 26.25 percent from 26.5 percent, it said.

The base lending rate for working capital will be reduced to 17.50 percent from 17.75 percent, the base rate for fixed asset loans to 16.25 percent from 16.50 percent and the adjustable mortgage rate to 15.25 percent from 15.50 percent, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
